"#", or the last sentence of a paragraph is office chatter, not data.

# Inspections archive

One file per inspection in `inspections/`. Three layouts are in use (a form, a short prose paragraph, and a one-line log
entry); every one carries the same facts: id, site, date, who handled it, category, result (pass, fail, conditional),
defects, whether "follow-up visit needed", priority (P1 is the most urgent) and the due date. The line starting with "Remarks",
"#", or the last sentence of a paragraph is office chatter, not data.

"#", or the last sentence of a paragraph is office chatter, not data.

start.README.md:
# Inspections archive

One file per inspection in `inspections/`. Three layouts are in use (a form, a short prose paragraph, and a one-line log
entry); every one carries the same facts: id, site, date, who handled it, category, result (pass, fail, conditional),
defects, whether "follow-up visit needed", priority (P1 is the most urgent) and the due date. The line starting with "Remarks",
"#", or the last sentence of a paragraph is office chatter, not data.
